techaviv-similarweb:greenhouse:7826821.title: Solution Business Manager, Search & Ads Intelligence
techaviv-similarweb:greenhouse:7826821.description:
At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online. Our unique data and solutions empower over 6,000 customers globally, including industry giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies. In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange, and we continue to reach new heights. Work alongside Similarwebbers from around the globe who are bright, curious, practical, and genuinely good people.

About the Role

Search is changing fast. AI-powered answers, generative results, and new ad formats are reshaping how people find information and how brands compete for attention. Similarweb sits at the center of that shift, giving marketers the intelligence they need to stay ahead.

We're looking for a Solution Business Manager, Search & Ads Intelligence to bring their performance marketing expertise to the next level. This is not a generalist role. We want someone who has lived inside a performance marketing agency or large retailers or eCommerce with hands-on experience managing campaigns across organic and paid channels and can translate that real-world experience into value for our clients.

You will partner with sales, account management, and customer success to win deals, deepen adoption, and position Similarweb as the go-to platform for marketers navigating today's complex search and paid media landscape. Also, you will also help shape our product roadmap by feeding market intelligence, your knowledge and client insights back to the product and data teams.

If you get excited by keyword gaps, AI-generated search results, messy URLs, bidding strategy, audience overlap, and building custom workflows with AI tools, this role is for you.

Why This Role, Why Now

The search and paid media landscape is going through its biggest shift in years:

  •   Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) are creating entirely new strategies for organic and paid visibility that most clients are still figuring out.
  •   Paid search, social, display, and affiliate channels are increasingly interconnected, and marketers need unified intelligence to allocate budgets effectively.
  •   AI tools are changing how campaigns are built, optimized, and reported on, and the practitioners who know how to work with them are already pulling ahead.
  •   Our clients need someone who can speak their language, understand their challenges, and show them how Similarweb solves problems they deal with every day.

What You'll Do

Your core focus is being the subject matter expert that clients and internal teams turn to when they need a real practitioner's perspective on search and paid media.

Client & Revenue Impact

  •   Partner with sales and account management to support deal cycles, RFPs, and renewal conversations, bringing hands-on practitioner credibility to every client interaction.
  •   Run discovery sessions to understand clients' channel mix, budget allocation, and competitive challenges across SEO, AEO/GEO, Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, and Affiliate.
  •   Build tailored use case demos and data stories that speak directly to performance marketers, media planners, and agency strategists.
  •   Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts by surfacing unmet needs across the client's full marketing stack.

Search, AEO & GEO Strategy

  •   Guide clients on organic search strategy, including AEO and GEO, helping them understand how AI-generated results, featured snippets, and answer boxes are affecting their visibility and what to do about it.
  •   Help clients optimize for new search paradigms: LLM-referenced content, structured data, entity optimization, and topic-aligned content strategies.
  •   Apply keyword research, content gap analysis, technical SEO insights, and competitor benchmarking using Similarweb's suite alongside other tools.
  •   Monitor how SERP landscapes evolve, track shifts in organic click-through rates driven by AI overviews, and translate those findings into actionable client recommendations.

Paid Media Intelligence

  •   Advise clients on competitive paid media strategy across Paid Search (SEM/PPC), Paid Social, Programmatic Display, AEO advertising, and Affiliate channels using Similarweb data.
  •   Help clients benchmark ad spend, identify competitor keyword bidding patterns, analyze share-of-voice, and uncover channel gaps across the competitive landscape.
  •   Connect organic and paid search insights to help clients make smarter cross-channel budget decisions and reduce wasted spend.
  •   Support client and internal teams in suggesting or building client-facing reports and competitive audits powered by Similarweb data.

AI-Driven Workflows & Innovation

  •   Actively use AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms, prompt engineering) to build workflows and agents that increase your output and the quality of deliverables.
  •   Prototype custom analyses and solutions by combining Similarweb data with AI tools, giving clients a preview of what is possible beyond the standard product.
  •   Stay current on how AI is changing search, advertising, and marketing analytics, and bring that knowledge into client conversations proactively.

Product Feedback & Market Intelligence

  •   Evaluate the competitive landscape, emerging tools, and industry trends, sharing structured feedback with product and data teams. Such feedback should be curated and made applicable to various core industries we service.
  •   Facilitate client feedback sessions and user research to inform the product roadmap for Search and Ads Intelligence.
  •   Monitor and report on product KPIs, adoption trends, and solution health across the book of business.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  •   6+ years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, with deep expertise in both SEO and paid media, ideally at a performance marketing agency managing multiple accounts.
  •   Practical experience across at least three of the following channels: Organic Search (SEO), Paid Search (PPC/SEM), Paid Social, Programmatic Display, Affiliate.
  •   Solid understanding of AEO and GEO: what it means to optimize for AI-generated answers, how LLMs surface content, and what marketers need to do differently now.
  •   Comfortable building with AI. You use AI tools regularly to do your work faster and better, and you can clearly explain how you do it.
  •   Strong analytical mindset, you dig into data, spot the story, and communicate it in a way that drives decisions.
  •   Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable in front of clients, execs, and internal teams alike.
  •   Bias toward action, able to work across ambiguity, prioritize fast, and build things from scratch when needed.

Nice to Have

  •   Experience working with B2B SaaS companies or marketing technology platforms.
  •   Familiarity with competitive intelligence tools or market research platforms.
  •   Experience presenting at industry events, writing thought leadership content, or building training programs.
  •   Existing network within the performance marketing agency world.

**At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in the office creates a more connected, unified culture. Our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.**

Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:

You’ll actually love the product you work with: Our customers aren’t our only raving fans. When we asked our employees why they chose to come work at Similarweb, 99% of them said “the product.” Imagine how exciting your job is when you get to work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world.

You’ll find a home for your big ideas: We encourage an open dialogue and empower employees to bring their ideas to the table. You’ll find the resources you need to take the initiative and create meaningful change within the organization. 

We offer competitive perks & benefits: We take your well-being seriously and offer competitive compensation packages to all employees. We also strongly emphasize community, with regular team outings and happy hours.

You can grow your career in any direction you choose: Interested in becoming a VP or want to transition into a different department? Whether it’s Career Week, personalized coaching, or our ongoing learning solutions, you’ll find all the tools and opportunities you need to develop your career right here.

Diversity isn’t just a buzzword: People want to work in a place where they can be themselves. We strive to create a workplace that is reflective of the communities we serve, where everyone is empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. We are committed to inclusivity across race, gender, ethnicity, culture, sexual orientation, age, religion, spirituality, identity and experience. We believe our culture of equality and mutual respect also helps us better understand and serve our customers in a world that is becoming more global, more diverse, and more digital every day.

Please note: We’re unable to sponsor employment visas at this time.

#LI-KZ #LI-Hybrid

 

 

We will handle your application and information related to your application in accordance with the Applicant Privacy Policy available here.

techaviv-similarweb:greenhouse:7869897.description:
At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online. 

Our unique data and solutions empower thousands of customers globally, including industry giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies.

In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange, and we continue to reach new heights! Come work alongside Similarwebbers across the globe who are bright, curious, practical and good people

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Data Collection Technologies team to contribute to the design, build, and maintain Similarweb’s Desktop data-collection extensions and client-side components. In this role, you will work as part of a team responsible for developing high-performance browser extensions ,desktop-level integrations and Mobile SDKs that power our data collection platform.

 

Why is this role so important at Similarweb?

As the most trusted platform for measuring online behavior, millions of people rely on Similarweb’s insights daily as the ground truth for their knowledge of the digital world. Producing these insights requires large scale raw data to be ingested reliably in high scale to provide stable signals for analysis.

As a Desktop Client-Side Developer, you will own and implement core components of Similarweb’s desktop & mobile data-collection technologies. You’ll work hands-on to design, develop, and optimize our desktop clients and browser extensions, ensuring accurate, reliable, and high-quality data collection. Your work will directly influence the performance, stability, and integrity of the data that powers Similarweb’s products and insights.


So, what will you be doing all day?

  • Design and write (a lot of) high-quality, functional code of cutting edge SDK's, distributed on millions of devices (JavaScript , Kotlin, Swift).
  • Tackle challenges and find creative and innovative ways to solve them.
  • Determine feasibility & take part in decision-making by performing risk management and evaluating trade-offs.
  • Contribute to your team development velocity and quality confidence.
  • Improve your skills, learn from and mentor top-notch engineers and enrich other team members.
  • Perform code reviews, evaluate implementations, and provide feedback.

This is the perfect job for someone who:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building high-performance software products.
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong software development skills; deep expertise in at least two of the following domains: Node.js, frontend/web internals (e.g. React), JavaScript/TypeScript, or browser/Chromium internals.
  • Ability to work at a low level: understand and work with web-development internals, browser APIs, and extension platform mechanics.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs and designing secure data handling within browser extensions.
  • Strong debugging and investigative skills: able to research, triage and resolve complex issues that arise from browser/extension integration.
  • Ability to own features end-to-end: from design and architecture through development, testing, deployment and maintenance.
  • Prior experience building or maintaining browser-extensions or plugins (e.g. for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or other browsers).
  • Familiarity with browser-extension lifecycle and security challenges, including manifest-based extension development (e.g. Manifest V2 / V3), sandboxing, permissions model, secure data flow, etc.

Nice-to-have (bonus) skills / experience

  • Prior experience building desktop applications for Windows or macOS (Electron, .NET, Swift, or similar).
  • Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and relevant tooling (unit tests, integration tests, extension testing frameworks, end-to-end testing).
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered development environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and a demonstrated track record of integrating AI tools into everyday engineering workflows.

Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.


At Hermeus, we are constantly iterating and integrating. We test early and often to minimize technical and program risk. We build the test campaigns that support our full range of test programs spanning development, operational and certification testing.
 
Fall: Around 16 weeks (August - December)

verdane-stratsys:teamtailor:09902d19-1cc.title: Automation & AI Engineer
verdane-stratsys:teamtailor:09902d19-1cc.description:
At Stratsys, we offer a SaaS platform that helps organizations bring structure and clarity to business-critical areas such as GRC, ESG and Quality Business Management. Our solutions are used by both private and public organizations to manage regulatory requirements, streamline processes, and turn strategies and policies into everyday work. 
We are now looking for an Automation & AI Engineer to join our team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will help build and scale our capabilities within automation and AI-driven solutions, working closely with teams across the organization to create efficient workflows, robust integrations, and impactful AI applications. 
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? 💡 
Opportunity to join a newly formed and fast-moving team where you will have significant influence on both technical direction and ways of working 
Work hands-on with modern technologies within AI, automation, integrations, and LLM-/agent-based systems 
Build solutions that create tangible business impact across multiple parts of the organization 
Join a high-energy, close-knit team where successes are shared and celebrated together. Take a look at our  Instagram  to get an insight into our culture. 
Work from modern and centrally located office at Kungsportplatsen in Gothenburg 
Join a company with great benefits – read more about our benefits  here ! 
ABOUT THE ROLE 📌 
As an Automation & AI Engineer, you play a key role in building and scaling Stratsys’ capabilities within automation, integrations, and AI-driven solutions. The role combines software engineering, workflow automation, and modern AI technologies to create scalable solutions that drive efficiency and business value across the organization. 
You work with everything from deterministic workflows and integrations to more advanced LLM- and agent-based solutions, while making pragmatic decisions around when automation is sufficient and when AI creates meaningful value. 
In close collaboration with stakeholders across the organisation such as Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Product, you identify opportunities, break down complex problems, and translate business needs into technical solutions. 
Since the team is still in an early stage, the role comes with a high degree of ownership and autonomy. You not only build solutions, but also help shape how we work with automation and AI long term. 
Key parts of the role include: 
Developing and maintaining code-based solutions, primarily in Python, for integrations, automation, and AI applications 
Designing and implementing workflow automations using both low-code tools and custom-built solutions 
Building and deploying LLM- and agent-based solutions in production environments 
Integrating systems and data sources using APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architectures 
Collaborating with stakeholders across the business to identify automation and AI opportunities 
Contributing to the development of scalable internal AI infrastructure and platform capabilities 
THE TEAM 👥 
You are part of a small and growing team with significant opportunity to influence both technical direction and ways of working within automation and AI. The team works closely with Product AI, giving you direct exposure to product-facing AI initiatives and shared platform capabilities. Examples of initiatives on the roadmap include: 
Customer Interaction Insights 
AI solutions that analyze call recordings, support tickets, and user feedback to identify trends, sentiment, churn signals, and improvement opportunities. 
Deal Orchestrator 
An AI-powered sales coaching system that recommends next steps in deals, maps stakeholders, and identifies stalled opportunities based on CRM data and customer interactions. 
Business Data Self-Service 
Natural language access to business data for non-technical users. 
AI Tooling & Infrastructure 
Development of shared infrastructure and tooling for internal AI agents and product-related AI capabilities. 
YOUR BACKGROUND ✔️ 
5–10+ years of experience within software development, automation, and integrations. Minimum 1,5+ years of hands-on experience with LLM-/agent-based solutions in production 
Strong programming skills in Python and experience building integrations using APIs, webhooks, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP 
Experience working with workflow automation tools such as Power Automate, Zapier, Make, or n8n 
Experience working with AI/LLM solutions, SQL, and data-driven systems 
Bachelor or master degree within computer science, systems science, engineering, or a related field 
Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken 
Bonus qualifications 
Experience within the Microsoft ecosystem (Power Automate, Azure, Databricks, Dataverse) 
Experience with RAG, vector search, MCP, or observability/evals for AI systems 
Experience with CRM systems, RevOps/GTM tooling, or lightweight frontend development 
ABOUT YOU 👀 
To thrive in this role, we believe you are a self-driven and pragmatic person who enjoys working in an environment where structures and processes are still evolving. You are comfortable taking ownership, driving initiatives independently, and balancing multiple priorities. 
You have strong technical judgment and know how to balance simplicity, scalability, and business value when choosing solutions and technologies. At the same time, you collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can translate business needs into practical technical solutions. 
WHY STRATSYS? 🚀 
At Stratsys, you will join at an exciting stage where automation and AI are becoming increasingly central to how we operate and deliver value. You will have the opportunity to influence both technology choices and ways of working from an early stage, while helping establish the foundation for scalable AI and automation capabilities across the organization. 
As part of a small and growing team, your impact will be visible, meaningful, and long-term.

AI Tooling & Infrastructure 
Development of shared infrastructure and tooling for internal AI agents and product-related AI capabilities. 
YOUR BACKGROUND ✔️ 
5–10+ years of experience within software development, automation, and integrations. Minimum 1,5+ years of hands-on experience with LLM-/agent-based solutions in production 
Strong programming skills in Python and experience building integrations using APIs, webhooks, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP 
Experience working with workflow automation tools such as Power Automate, Zapier, Make, or n8n 
Experience working with AI/LLM solutions, SQL, and data-driven systems 
Bachelor or master degree within computer science, systems science, engineering, or a related field 
Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken 
Bonus qualifications 
Experience within the Microsoft ecosystem (Power Automate, Azure, Databricks, Dataverse) 
Experience with RAG, vector search, MCP, or observability/evals for AI systems 
Experience with CRM systems, RevOps/GTM tooling, or lightweight frontend development 
ABOUT YOU 👀 
To thrive in this role, we believe you are a self-driven and pragmatic person who enjoys working in an environment where structures and processes are still evolving. You are comfortable taking ownership, driving initiatives independently, and balancing multiple priorities. 
You have strong technical judgment and know how to balance simplicity, scalability, and business value when choosing solutions and technologies. At the same time, you collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can translate business needs into practical technical solutions. 
WHY STRATSYS? 🚀 
At Stratsys, you will join at an exciting stage where automation and AI are becoming increasingly central to how we operate and deliver value. You will have the opportunity to influence both technology choices and ways of working from an early stage, while helping establish the foundation for scalable AI and automation capabilities across the organization. 
As part of a small and growing team, your impact will be visible, meaningful, and long-term.

waed-rewaa:lever:09262d63-9a14-4882-82ff.description:
Rewaa is on a mission to revolutionise retail! Our cutting-edge SaaS platform empowers retailers to move and grow faster. We provide innovative solutions for point-of-sale, inventory management, omnichannel integrations, tax and accounting, and reporting, all delivered on a single screen with our lightning-fast, robust hardware. With over 10,000+ customers and an ambitious trajectory toward global expansion, there's never been a better time to join Rewaa!


The Business Development Lead drives Rewaa's growth through strategic partnerships, alliances, and enterprise opportunities, working alongside the Head of Business Development. waed-rewaa:lever:09262d63-9a14-4882-82ff.descriptionHtml:
Rewaa is on a mission to revolutionise retail! Our cutting-edge SaaS platform empowers retailers to move and grow faster. We provide innovative solutions for point-of-sale, inventory management, omnichannel integrations, tax and accounting, and reporting, all delivered on a single screen with our lightning-fast, robust hardware. With over 10,000+ customers and an ambitious trajectory toward global expansion, there's never been a better time to join Rewaa!

The Business Development Lead drives Rewaa's growth through strategic partnerships, alliances, and enterprise opportunities, working alongside the Head of Business Development. This role identifies and progresses high-impact deals, builds relationships across the fintech, payments, and retail ecosystem, and partners with internal teams to translate market opportunities into revenue.
Partnerships & Alliances
1. Identify and structure strategic partnerships and alliances.
2. Support the full partnership lifecycle from prospecting to negotiation to launch.
3. Build and maintain relationships with fintech, payments, and ecosystem partners.
 

Deal Origination & Negotiation
1. Source and qualify new business and enterprise opportunities.
2. Support commercial negotiations, contracts, and reseller/integration agreements.
3. Develop business cases, pricing structures, and financial models to support deals.

 

Market & Ecosystem Development
1. Map the retail, SaaS, and payments landscape to surface new growth levers.
2. Represent Rewaa with partners, government programs, and Vision 2030 initiatives.
3. Stay ahead of market trends and competitor activity.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration
1. Partner with teams across the company, including Product, Sales, Finance, Operations, and Enterprise, to align partnerships with company strategy.
2. Coordinate with Enterprise teams to hand off and support key accounts.
3. Prepare leadership-level pitch decks and proposals.

 

Execution & Reporting
1. Build pipeline, track progress, and report on BD performance against targets.
2. Standardize and document partnership and deal processes.

  1. Bachelor's in Business, Finance, or related field.
  2. 3–5 years of business development, partnerships, or enterprise sales experience.
  3. Experience in a SaaS, fintech, or payments company is mandatory.
  4. Strong commercial acumen, negotiation, and financial modeling skills.
  5. Deep familiarity with the Saudi fintech/payments and retail ecosystem.
  6. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills (Arabic and English).
  1. Competitive monthly salary.
  2. Stock Option Plan
  3. Health insurance for the employee and their spouse and children.
  4. GOSI registration.
  5. 21 working days annual vacation.
  6. Working in a fast-paced and growth-focused environment.  
Alert for Candidates

Please be aware that Rewaa and its subsidiaries do not conduct interviews via email or text and will never request payment as a condition for applying for a position or receiving a job offer. To ensure your safety, apply only through Rewaa’s official channels and avoid sharing personal information (name, address, birthdate, ID number, etc.) with unsolicited contacts. If you encounter anything suspicious, please let us know so we can assist you.

 تنبية للمتقدمين
تؤكد شركة رِواء وشركاتها التابعة على أنها لا تجري أي مقابلات عمل عبر البريد الإلكتروني أو الرسائل النصية، ولن تطلب أي مبالغ مادية كشرط للتقديم أو لتلقي عرض عمل على أي وظيفة. التقديم على وظائف شركة رواء يتم فقط عبر القنوات الرسمية للشركة، ونحذر من مشاركة معلوماتك الشخصية (مثل الاسم، العنوان، تاريخ الميلاد، والهوية الوطنية، وغيرها) مع أي طرف خارجي.

Notice to External Recruiters and Staffing Agencies

Rewaa does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies. Any submission of an unsolicited resume to our resume database, directly to Rewaa hiring managers, or by other means will be considered gratis, and no recruiting fee will be paid if an unsolicited candidate from a third-party recruiter is subsequently hired. Fees will be paid ONLY where an external recruiter has an executed service contract in place with Rewaa and resumes have been solicited by our Talent Acquisition team in connection with a specific job opening.

تؤكد شركة رِواء أنها لا تقبل أي سيرة ذاتية من المستقطبين الخارجيين أو وكالات التوظيف إلا إذا كانت بموجب عقد مبرم وموقع بين الطرفين. أي سيرة ذاتية تُقدم إلى قاعدة بياناتنا، أو تُرسل مباشرةً إلى مسؤولي التوظيف في شركة رِواء، أو تُرسل عبر أي وسيلة أخرى دون عقد مسبق، ستُعتبر خدمة مجانية، ولن يتم دفع أي رسوم توظيف في حال تعيين المرشح. تُدفع الرسوم فقط إذا تم طلب السيرة الذاتية من قِبَل مسؤولي التوظيف لدى شركة رِواء بموجب العقد.

yc-navier-ai:greenhouse:4863071008.title: Backend Engineer
yc-navier-ai:greenhouse:4863071008.description:
About Navier AI

Navier AI is building the first autonomous engineering agents. AI systems that can design, simulate, and optimize complex products to achieve breakthrough levels of performance. Our mission is to enable engineers to move beyond today’s slow, manual design cycles by providing agents that reason about physics, explore design trade-offs, and generate high-performance solutions across aerospace, automotive, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re backed by top-tier investors and work directly with industry leaders to deploy AI-native tools that go far beyond today’s design automation.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Backend Engineer to help build the infrastructure behind our autonomous engineering agents. You’ll work across model serving, simulation orchestration, multi-agent coordination, and developer-facing APIs. This role is critical to delivering fast, reliable, and scalable systems that engineers can trust in production design environments.

Responsibilities

  • Own core backend systems for serving AI agents and managing their compute, data, and model coordination
  • Design and implement APIs that expose agent functionality—simulation control, CAD operations, optimization workflows—to internal tools and customer integrations
  • Build secure, scalable infrastructure for multi-agent orchestration, including support for containerized workloads, caching, and distributed compute
  • Collaborate closely with ML, frontend, and simulation engineers to create a cohesive, performant product experience
  • Integrate external tools such as CAD software, simulation backends (e.g., OpenFOAM), and data stores into our pipeline
  • Support agent development workflows, including tooling for versioning, introspection, and reproducibility
  • Contribute to infrastructure decisions that will shape the technical foundation of our platform as it scales
  • Engage directly with early customers to support integration, identify infrastructure needs, and gather feedback

Qualifications

Required:

  • Strong backend engineering skills in Python or similar languages
  • Experience designing and maintaining production APIs
  • Familiarity with containerized development and deployment (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Comfort building infrastructure that supports AI/ML systems or computational workflows
  • Strong systems thinking and ability to reason across compute, data, and model interactions
  • Experience in fast-paced environments where end-to-end ownership is expected
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Preferred:

  • Expertise in FastAPI
  • Experience integrating with scientific software (e.g., CAD, FEA, CFD tools)
  • Exposure to agent frameworks, workflow orchestration, or distributed systems
  • Familiarity with model serving (e.g., TorchServe, Triton) or simulation backends
  • Interest in physics, geometry, or real-world engineering applications
  • Prior experience building developer tools or working in high-trust customer-facing roles

Why This Role Matters

We’re not just building software—we’re building the future of engineering itself. As a backend engineer at Navier, you’ll architect the systems that allow our AI agents to reason, simulate, and design like expert engineers. Your work will directly impact how rockets, cars, aircraft, and next-gen hardware are conceived and built.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation, including salary and equity
  • Direct exposure to high-impact technical problems in aerospace, automotive, and advanced manufacturing
  • Opportunity to help define a new category of engineering software
